notes: §1985:XI.4.1.3 SR6: 'No two files specified in any one MERGE statement may reside on the same multiple file reel.' ScreenMultipleFileClause records each MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause as one reel on its files (FileModel.MultipleFileReels), and BindMerge calls ScreenMultipleFileReels, which refuses (COBOL6815) any reel holding two of the statement's SD, USING and GIVING files; the clause is a 1985 element (COBOL0902 from 2002), so the rule reaches only the 85 edition and its permissive later ones. Probes at --std 85: the witness (USING IN1 IN2 on one reel), USING IN1 EXTRA GIVING IN2 with IN1/IN2 on a reel, and a reel of OUT1 EXTRA IN1 against USING IN1 IN2 GIVING OUT1 are refused; a reel naming one statement file and a file outside the statement, two clauses putting IN1 and IN2 on separate reels, POSITION phrases, a file shared by two reels whose other members are not both in the statement, and a SORT whose USING files share a reel (§1985:XI.4.4.3 SR7 allows it) all compile.

next.reason: 1985: "No two files specified in any one MERGE statement may reside on the same multiple file reel."; 2023: "The MERGE syntax rules (SR-14.9.24.3-1 to -13) state no reel-placement restriction; only SAME clauses and repeated file-names are restricted.". The 2023 MERGE syntax rules cover file-name reuse and SAME clauses but drop the multiple-file-reel restriction. No candidate covers multiple file reels.
